inputs.name: planningService.base
inputs.description: The base Git adapter supplied to construct the planning service. The service uses it to create operation-scoped read adapters and to run plan writes, so it must support the Git behavior those operations invoke.

outputs.name: planningService
outputs.description: The returned API exposes project snapshots, plan, branch, commit, image, and entity-history reads, plus plan, design, and thread operations. Each method obtains a Git adapter through planReads, and write methods clone their input before passing work through planWrite.

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: The plan-creation path can fail during its validation checks or when a plan already exists; the duplicate case is raised as already-exists with the message Plan already exists. Snapshot catches per-plan read failures and records their code and message in rejected instead of rejecting the whole snapshot.
